Rajat: Minimal flow: SSE stream -> translator -> POST /tool-handler. Keeps their ingestion pipeline unchanged.
Owen: Procurement ask: one-pager hosted vs 12mo Dedicated for ~60 RPS @ 950 tokens/req. Include assumptions (model, avg response length, cache hit-rate).

ops-bot: Created ticket VG-902 for translator deploy and docs handoff (assignee: Rajat).

``
translator:
  mode: sse
  forward_toolcalls: webhook
  webhook_url: http://127.0.0.1:8080/tool
  tls: terminate
``
Owen: I'll draft pricing one-pager with hosted token ranges and Dedicated estimate; will call out network/egress.
